prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. Scan area for object, approach it, take it, get its properties. Move, if path clear. list of available nodes: <Action ID = ScanForObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessObjectProperties    /> <Action ID = MoveToLocation    /> <Sequence>     <Action ID = FindAndGrabObject    />     <Fallback>         <Sequence>             <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />             <Action ID = TakeObject    />             <SubTree ID = ProcessObjectProperties    />         </Sequence>         <Sequence>             <Condition ID = IsPathClear    />             <Action ID = MoveToLocation    />         </Sequence>         <Action ID = ScanForObject    />     </Fallback> </Sequence>"
code:
SELECTOR
		SEQUENCE
				IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
				DO TakeObject
		ELSE
			DO ProcessObjectProperties
		END
		SEQUENCE
				IF IsPathClear? THEN
				DO MoveToLocation
		END
		DO ScanForObject
	END
